description: This is a test source file for the SettingsDialog component in an Android application, containing UI tests for different states and configurations of the settings dialog.

classes.name: SettingsDialogTest
classes.description: Test class for the SettingsDialog UI component, verifying different UI states and interactions.

methods.name: whenLoading_showsLoadingText
methods.description: Tests that the loading state displays the loading text.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_allDefaultSettingsAreDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies that all default settings are displayed and correctly selected when the state is success.

methods.description: Ensures dynamic color options are hidden when support is disabled.
